```{r}
#| include: false
```

## Projection identity

For scenario $s$ and year $t\ge 2027$,

::: {.formula-box}
$$
E_{s,t}=E_{s,2027}(1+h_s)^{t-2027},
$$
$$
P_{s,t}=E_{s,t}\,\widehat{ELR}_{2024}\,m_s(1+g_s)^{t-2027}(1+\lambda_s),
$$
:::

where $E$ is annual-sales exposure, $m$ initial risk stress, $g$ annual risk trend, $h$ exposure growth and $\lambda$ a prudence margin.

## Assumptions

```{r}
#| label: tbl-assumptions
#| tbl-cap: "Visible scenario assumptions"
display <- data.frame(
  Scenario = assumptions$scenario_label,
  `Initial stress` = paste0(formatC(assumptions$initial_risk_stress, digits = 2, format = "f"), "×"),
  `Annual risk trend` = fmt_pct(assumptions$annual_risk_trend),
  `Exposure growth` = fmt_pct(assumptions$annual_exposure_growth),
  `Prudence margin` = fmt_pct(assumptions$prudence_margin),
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(display, align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"))
```

![Conditional internet-risk provision scenarios](artifacts/public/figures/provision-scenarios.png){fig-alt="Annual provisions from 2027 to 2031 under resilience improvement, persistent conditions and systemic stress, with 2031 empirical uncertainty intervals."}

The resilience scenario is an explicit improvement assumption, not a forecast. Persistent conditions hold the calibrated risk ratio constant before exposure growth. Systemic stress increases the initial risk level and subsequent trend.

## Results per 10 million TND starting exposure

```{r}
#| label: tbl-provisions
#| tbl-cap: "Annual and cumulative conditional provisions"
selected <- projections[projections$projection_year %in% c(2027, 2031), ]
display <- data.frame(
  Scenario = selected$scenario_label,
  Year = selected$projection_year,
  `Expected loss` = fmt_tnd(selected$expected_economic_loss_tnd),
  `Risk-adjusted provision` = fmt_tnd(selected$risk_adjusted_provision_tnd),
  `95% sampling band` = paste0(
    fmt_tnd(selected$risk_adjusted_provision_lower_tnd), " – ",
    fmt_tnd(selected$risk_adjusted_provision_upper_tnd)
  ),
  `Cumulative through year` = fmt_tnd(selected$cumulative_provision_tnd),
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(display, align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"))
```

::: {.callout-important title="Provision terminology"}
“Provision” means a conditional management risk budget. It is not a statutory technical provision, IFRS 17 liability, IAS 37 provision, operator financial estimate, insurance premium or booked reserve.
:::
